Question 14
?

If X={1,3,5,…,99}, which collection of subsets of X is a partition of X?

a
{{1,3,5,…,49},{51,53,55,…,99}}
b
{{1,3,5,…,69},{70,71,72,…,99}}
c
{{1,3,5,…,39},{51,53,55,…,99}}
d
{{1,3,5,…,99},{2,4,6,…,98}}

{{1,3,5,…,49},{41,43,45,…,99}}
